summary: Columbus Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K disclosing a monthly extension deposit of $50,000 into its trust account, funded equally by working capital and the target WISeSat.Space Corp., to extend the deadline for its initial business combination from April 22, 2026 to May 22, 2026. The extension is permitted under the charter up to January 22, 2027. The registrant is a blank-check company (SPAC) pursuing a de-SPAC deal. The target contributes to extension fees, signaling commitment. Watch for subsequent extension filings or a business combination vote; risk-arb centers on deal closure and redemption risk.
